title: G2.0 - Stabilize G1 delivery baseline
intent: Make the completed G1 domain skeleton a trustworthy base for G2 implementation.
scope: Close or explicitly adjudicate repository verification failures, verify the G1 migration path, freeze rollback and compatibility boundaries, and produce a maintainer-grade review package.
non_goals: Implement G2.1 AgentDefinition, AgentVersion, Deployment, or EvaluationRun capability
Implement RunAttempt, Runner, GitHub Connector, Artifact, Evidence, Submission, DeliveryReview, or Acceptance capability
Reinterpret inherited Project, Issue, Heartbeat, Artifact, or Run facts as native Verrail facts
Publish, merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record without explicit user approval
acceptance_criteria: All G1 focused, Go, typecheck, build, migration, token, locale, and browser gates pass.
Every repository-wide test failure is fixed or explicitly baselined with reproducible evidence and ownership.
Forward migration, rollback strategy, and compatibility boundaries are canonical and reviewable.
The complete G1 diff has a maintainer-grade review report with all critical and high findings resolved.
G2 begins from a documented green or explicitly adjudicated baseline.
